title: OLE Resource Envelope
description: Common envelope fields shared by all OLE resources. Draft schema — v0.1. Every OLE resource must include these fields. Modules may add fields but must not remove or redefine envelope fields.

id.description: Stable identifier assigned by the issuing system. Must not be reassigned to a different resource.

oleVersion.description: OLE version used by this resource, e.g., '0.1'.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the resource was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the resource was last updated. Recommended.

createdBy.description: OLE Actor ID of the actor that created this resource. Recommended.

owningInstitution.description: OLE Institution ID of the institution responsible for this resource. Recommended.

visibility.description: Intended access scope declaration. Required on all OLE resources.

scope.description: Visibility scope. 'private': owning actor/institution only. 'participant_visible': named participants. 'institution_visible': owning institution. 'network_visible': defined network. 'public': public release. 'aggregate_public': public after aggregation thresholds.

platformContext.description: Identifies the software platform that created, transmitted, or hosts this resource. Enables adoption measurement and interoperability debugging. RECOMMENDED.

originatingPlatform.description: System that created this resource (e.g., certusgate, clio, smokeball). Set once at creation, never changes.

transmittingPlatform.description: System that sent or relayed this resource. May differ from originating.

hostingPlatform.description: System currently storing and serving this resource.

conformanceTier.description: OLE conformance tier implemented by the originating platform.

type.description: Type of identifier within that system.

extensions.description: Namespaced implementer-specific fields. Must not redefine core field meanings. Field names should use '{namespace}:{fieldName}' pattern.
